notes.title: Getting closer to launch!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]It's been a bit since my last update. However, I have some pretty exciting news for y'all. As you can see by the title, the game is approaching its release![/p][h2]What's been being worked on?[/h2][p]Since my last post, [b]the main gameplay loop has been finished![/b] You can complete the main objectives, collect items, die to enemies, and more. The only other parts of the gameplay that need to be finished up are some enemies, items, achievements, and the [i]modifiers[/i] part of the game; I'll get into what those modifiers are in a future post or YouTube video. [/p][p]Aside from these, all that's left for the game are some additions to the settings menu, some touch-ups to the main menu, and overall polishing. I'm super excited to launch this game (hopefully next month), and thank you all for your support so far; the game has received nearly 800 wishlists![/p][p]Since I haven't had much to show since I'd like to keep it all a surprise for the next YouTube devlog on the game and pre-launch/launch trailers, here's a little look at the game's safe room/lobby![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650505/3fa9ad36c4720d24353c9fbbd5fa42b0e2376507.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650505/353427bc7dc8868c017c0275747ac2c8ea817e10.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]-Hunter Allen[/p]

notes.title: Quick Update on Development
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, this is the first news/event post on the page! Before I go over this post, thank you all for 500 wishlists! I wasn't expecting to get that many before the first trailer of the game, so thank you all again![/p][h3][b]Why do the game page screenshots look blurry?[/b][/h3][p]While taking screenshots for the game page, I hadn't realized how blurry the screenshots would end up looking. During most of development, I have had a post processing layer that replicates some VHS/CRT effects, one of which being stretching (blurring). I didn't turn this off for the screenshots, hence the blurriness; I will be adding a slider for this and many other effects in game so both people who like the effect and don't like it can be happy. I plan on updating this game page to have quite a few more screenshots within the next month or so, so keep an eye out for a page graphics update coming soon![/p][h3][b]What is being worked on currently?[/b][/h3][p]As of this post being made, the main two things that have been in progress are the environments, programming for the main gameplay loop, and bug fixes before the next major alpha testing build.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650505/6a9f8c0e3d64aa15db7f8d4266869586c18d327a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650505/ababba37d14f286a6897664e50d126d820777074.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650505/d406cfc79399a920606df35b044efb984099f01d.png"][/img][/carousel][p]That's all I have to share for now, since I want to keep a good chunk of stuff secret for when the game's pre-release trailer drops. Again, thank you guys for your support and patience![/p][p]-Hunter Allen[/p]
